Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, ordain in what You decree and determine
And in what You distinguish from the wise commands
In the Night of Power (Laylatul Qadr)

Arabic text: وَ فِيْ الْقَضَاءِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَدُّ وَلَا يُبَدَّلُ
Translation: And in the decree which cannot be rejected nor changed

Arabic text: اَنْ تَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
Translation: That You write me among the pilgrims of Your Sacred House
And ordain in what You decree and determine
